title: Viewport Management
description: Pan and zoom transformations between world and screen coordinates.
body: Pan and zoom. The viewport is the only place screen coordinates and world coordinates meet: everything else in the engine works in world units, so a zoom change never touches the document. `x` and `y` are the world point drawn at the Schematic's top-left corner. `zoom` is screen pixels per world unit — the number the readout draws as a percentage (PRD §12.1).
